description: Manifest for independently authored F1 spelling, identity, exact-time, voicing, measure, and bounded-decoder authority fixtures.

authorityPolicy.authoringMethod: manual derivation from reviewed contracts and explicit arithmetic
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not regenerate expected values from the implementation under test.
Do not collapse spelled identity to MIDI or pitch-class equality.
Do not use floating-point equality for beat arithmetic.
Do not repair, sort, respell, deduplicate, or optimize Manual or Frozen pitches.
Do not partially commit an ID remap after any allocation collision.
Do not silently relax a limit or completion declaration.
Do not invent cancellation or revision-staleness semantics inside synchronous F1 value operations.

determinism.caseOrdering: lexicographic by globally unique case ID
determinism.integerArithmetic: BigInt intermediates, reduced before the bounded-number conversion
determinism.seedUse: Seeds control future mutation/property input order only; checked-in expected values remain hand-authored.

stableSeeds.purpose: rational normalization, closure, and ordering mutations
meter capacity and measure completion mutations

assumptions.text: For pickup and incomplete states, expectedDuration is the exact declared occupied duration and must equal the sum of event durations; that duration is positive and below ordinary meter capacity.
Text limits count Unicode code points, not UTF-16 code units or UTF-8 bytes.
Pitch projection, beat arithmetic, capacity calculation, shape construction, and copy-plan allocation are synchronous pure F1 operations with no base revision and no cancellation token.

For non-rootless Auto families without a slash bass, generated, external, and none are structurally legal; with a slash bass, generated and external are legal and none is not. Rootless families require external in both cases.

companions.role: spelled pitch identity, MIDI projection, frequency, and boundary refusals
degree identity and parsed/custom structural distinctions
all PPQ divisors, normalized exact arithmetic, ranges, overflow, and timeline boundaries
all fifteen 2/2 through 6/8 capacities and completion states
stable IDs, deep copy remaps, duplicate paths, and atomic collision failures
Auto policy matrix, Manual/Frozen exactness, and Custom chord conditions
document/key/instrument shapes plus positive, malformed, and exact limit boundaries
explicit cancellation and stale-state applicability declarations
